The fine_grained_classifier ranked 'ice lolly' and 'ear' (ambiguous) above 'corn', but visually the object is clearly corn. Since the object identity is fundamentally wrong (wrong species, wrong structure, no stalk), the alignment is near zero. The single passing checkpoint (color) is irrelevant given the class error.
